name: Stonehenge: The Hidden Truth
overview:
As one of the world’s most famous ancient landmarks, the mysterious Stonehenge has captivated global attention. Constructed 4340 years ago, this colossal edifice represents the pinnacle of the Stonehenge landscape and stands as the last great megalithic monument of the Neolithic Age, a symbol of an era’s end.

In this documentary, a team of experts deploys cutting-edge scientific technologies to survey the massive hidden earth ring newly discovered at Stonehenge. For the first time, archaeologists use optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating technology to determine the exact formation date of this long-concealed earth ring, uncovering new clues to the ancient mystery of Stonehenge.
